design_implications: Do not promise logout persistence with current Linger=no.
Persistent executor startup and disk ledger/spool are separate from transient child job survival.
Reboot interrupts running processes; reconcile durable job records instead of assuming automatic job resurrection.
Launch acknowledgement must include durable job identity and executable readiness, not SSH exit alone.
Use validated absolute executable profiles; remote noninteractive PATH lacks native agent CLIs.
